_read_me: Which code each document claims to describe. Checked by tests/docs_aligned.py: if a watched path moved after the document was last edited, the document is UNREVIEWED — not proven wrong, proven unchecked. Add every new file under docs/ here; the check fails on any document it does not know about, because a doc nobody watches is exactly how prose goes stale. Keep the watched paths NARROW: a doc that watches the whole repository is behind every day and gets ignored, which is worse than no check at all.

docs/planet.md.why: The planet doc describes what the map shows and how it responds — all of it lives in index.html, fed by graph_export.py.

docs/design-doc.md.why: The design doc explains recall, the health check, the maintenance loop and the agent roster. It deliberately does NOT watch every hook: a doc that watches all 36 is behind every week and stops being read.

docs/translation.md.why: The translation doc describes the fr → main chain: what is copied, what is rewritten, and by which rules.

docs/install-model.md.why: The install model describes who owns the engine and how a version is built, switched and rolled back. It is only true while the installer, the updater and the uninstaller agree on it — those three write and read the versions/ tree between them.

docs/verification-recipe.md.why: The recipe tells a reader how to verify the package for themselves — it is only true while these three behave as described.
